title: Oil Rich Japanese Speck Ramen
description: A fatty and creamy Japanese Kyushu dish featuring speck, this recipe is perfect for a comforting meal. It is also anti-inflammatory friendly and can be served from a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the ramen noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add the sliced speck to the pot and cook until crispy.
Remove the speck from the pot and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to a bowl and top with the speck, green onions, and sesame seeds.
Pour the hot broth over the top and serve immediately.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve from a lazy-susan-spinner vessel for a fun and interactive meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
